definitions: A mixture of tallow and oil used to soften leather, and make it waterproof.

blocks.text: Dubbin is a greasy or waxy product used to soften, condition, and waterproof leather. It has been used since medieval times to waterproof and soften leather goods. It differs from saddle soap used to clean and lightly condition leather, or shoe polish, which is used to impart shine and colour to it.
